### Maintainer Checklist (For Drips Wave)
- [ ] Ensure issue is clearly scoped and actionable.
- [ ] Add issue to the active Wave Program via Drips App or label.
- [ ] Set Complexity:
  - [ ] **Trivial** (100 Pts): Minor fix, typo, simple UI glitch.
  - [ ] **Medium** (150 Pts): Standard bug fix requiring logic changes.
  - [ ] **High** (200 Pts): Complex state bugs, difficult repro, or architectural fix.
